title: How much stress have you been carrying lately?
intro: Stress doesn't always hit all at once. Sometimes it slowly builds over time until your mind and body stop feeling fully rested. Chronic stress can affect emotional regulation, mental clarity, energy levels, and nervous system recovery. This check-in is designed to help you recognize how long-term stress accumulation may currently be affecting you.

options.text: Emotionally overloaded most of the time
Mentally overstimulated and unable to slow down
Like I haven't truly recovered in a long time

questions.text: When responsibilities pile up, I usually:

options.text: Ignore how badly I need rest and recovery
I've been functioning on low energy for too long
My nervous system cannot fully settle
I desperately need recovery and decompression

questions.text: People around me probably see me as:
What do you need most right now?

options.text: True recovery and time to reset

a.description: You feel mentally weighed down by constant responsibilities and pressure. The load rarely lets up, even when you wish it would.

b.description: You feel emotionally full, overwhelmed, and mentally overloaded most of the time. There's a lot happening beneath the surface.

c.description: You continue functioning and staying productive despite deep exhaustion. From the outside things look fine — but you know how tired you really are.

d.description: You struggle finding mental quiet and feel constantly overstimulated. Slowing down can feel almost impossible right now.

e.description: You haven't had enough emotional or nervous system recovery for a long time. Real rest — not just downtime — is what your system is asking for.
